name: Claude Code
description: Installs Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic coding CLI, from the official APT repository.

version.description: APT package version of claude-code to install. Use "latest" for the newest available version, or an exact version string as reported by `apt-cache policy claude-code`.

keepAptSource.description: Keep the Claude Code APT source and signing key in the image so the package can be upgraded later. When false, both are removed after installation.
